findings.summary: NEXT_LOCALE cookie value could reach a plain-object lookup via the prototype chain, crashing the mandatory landing page.
Server and client independently recomputed time-left, risking a hydration mismatch at a minute boundary.
Days value not clamped to the documented 00-99 range.
.env.example was silently excluded from git by the blanket .env* ignore rule.
